name: Thumbnail CTR row
oneLiner: the brand's own thumbnails drop in as glass video cards (a row on 16:9, a studio-style list on 9:16), each with a metric chip that counts up and a bar that fills; then the set splits at once: the weak ones drain to grey and sink, the strong ones lift with a lit green rim and green chips
say: when the speaker compares thumbnails or posts by a number ("put them side by side and it's obvious: these four pull 6%, those three don't"): cut in on the first thumbnail; the split lands on "obvious". Set values to the real numbers, label and unit to the metric
